subsystem.name: UiPlatformAndOptions
subsystem.responsibility: Reconstruction of the ui_platform_and_options scope: the DirectX renderer/surface configuration path (device init, device configuration, surface blit, buffer creation), UI element/scene operations (color, position, property, focus and bitfield-state setters), plus a heterogeneous set of platform/utility helpers (audio resample table, stream serialization, GUID formatting, rotation matrix, sparse matrix pattern, thread/mutex synchronization, locale refcount). Boundaries follow the scope packet's function selection; most classes are synthesis over UnknownObject owners.

summary: 19 functions in the ui_platform_and_options scope reconstruct as: (1) a DirectX renderer configuration object (GraphicsDeviceConfiguration) covering surface initialization 0x0053D4F0, device configuration 0x0053E070, format-aware surface blit 0x0053FD40 and device buffer creation 0x00540DF0, all sharing the this+0x10FC..0x1580 config region and the DirectX adapter/device callee set; (2) UI element operations (UiElement: 0x00543800 color, 0x00543870 position, 0x0055D410 property) and an element-list manager (UiSceneManager: 0x0054BDC0 bitfield state, 0x0054F7A0 focus/render) sharing the UI-root global 0x008B8F28; (3) standalone helpers with no this-field evidence: AudioResampleFilterTableBuilder 0x00502C28, StreamSerializationHelper 0x005355F0, GuidFormatter 0x0053D8E0, RotationMatrixBuilder 0x00541DB0, SparseMatrixPatternBuilder 0x0056C830; (4) synchronization objects: ThreadResumeController 0x00585680, MutexGuardedFieldWriter 0x00585CD0, LocaleFacet 0x00598C1C, ThreadSafeCounter 0x00598C4A. Every function owner is UnknownObject in the packet, so all class boundaries, method groupings and field names are GUESS synthesis; offsets, addresses, globals, callees and literals are taken verbatim from packet evidence.

function_roles.role: Builds a sample-rate-conversion filter table: guards a1/a2 nonzero, computes ratio a2/a1, estimates a size via CRTFtol (0x00587BDC), allocates via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper (0x00587C03), then fills two-phase (source-index dword, weight float) record pairs per output position with clamp (a3==0) or wrap mode, writes per-phase byte lengths and the total table size at the end. Returns the table pointer, or null on guard/allocation failure.

Serializes the 32-bit value a2 as four least-significant-byte-first bytes through BufferedCharacterWriteWithOverflowHandling (0x00589898), shifting a2 right by 8 each iteration; returns the last write result. Called by StreamFileTypeCheckWithDispatch (0x005355A0).

Initializes the DirectX renderer configuration object: resets device globals 0x008B6AC8 / 0x008B6AB8, zero-initializes eight render-pass sub-structures via StructZeroInitConstructor (0x00553DE0) at 17-dword strides from dword index 1118, then applies fixed defaults: zeroed state, 8192/32768 buffer limits, identity 1.0f scales, debug color key 11513775, 640x480 viewport with 7680x1200 backing, and buffer parameters 512/6. Returns this.

Formats a 16-byte GUID as the hyphenated hex string "%.8X-%.4X-%.4X-%.2X%.2X-%.2X%.2X%.2X%.2X%.2X%.2X" (format literal at 0x005DBC5C) via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck (0x0058815F), reading Data1 (+0x0), Data2 (+0x4), Data3 (+0x6) and eight Data4 bytes (+0x8..+0xF). Called from VidMan_Enter (0x004FA000).

Configures the Direct3D device: releases prior renderer resources (0x0053EAD0), rebuilds device state when this+0x1100 is null (0x0053D970), creates three audio emitters at this+0x1524/0x1528/0x152C, negotiates display/backbuffer/depth-stencil formats and multisample modes through the adapter vtable, selects format codes, configures windowed/fullscreen present parameters, creates the device, sets the render target, configures the audio emitter device, extracts capability flags, and returns -1 on any setup failure (else the negated verification result of 0x0053EB70).

Performs a format-aware surface blit: prepares a format buffer (0x0055C650), prepares/allocates the destination surface (0x0053F720), selects source/destination surfaces from the a2/a4 descriptors via the a3/a5 1/2/4/8 flag bits, blits via SurfaceBlitOperation (0x0050099C) with a fill color derived from a4[6], releases temporary surfaces through vtable+8, and optionally copies via D3DSurfaceCopyBlit (0x00500BC8) when a4[11]>1. Stores -1 in *this at the first failure; returns 0 on success; skips the pipeline when a6 & 0x1000000.

Creates a device vertex/index buffer by invoking vtable slot 23 (byte offset 92) on the sub-object at this+0x1100, building a usage/format flag word from this+0x1138 and a2[0] bits, a size a2[2]*a2[3], descriptor a2[1]/mode/a2+8, and storing the handle in this+0x0. Returns 0 on success; logs aInvalidParamet / aErrorCreatingV and returns -1 otherwise.

Builds a 3x3 rotation matrix from Euler angles a2/a3/a4 (each passed through InterruptDispatch 0x0058957A), storing the angles at this+0x30/0x34/0x38, the matrix at this+0x15C..0x188 (4th column zeroed, 1.0f at 0x198), and transforms the orientation vector at this+0x24/0x28/0x2C into this+0x18C/0x190/0x194. Returns 0.

Normalizes three 0-255 byte components to floats via 1/255 (global 0x0059E460) and stores them at this+0x17C/0x180/0x184, dispatches a packed color update through the object at global 0x008B78A0 via VTableDispatchWithFieldCheck (0x00541670), and ORs the 0x800 refresh flag into offset +0xEC of the UI root at global 0x008B8F28. Returns the UI root pointer.

UI element position setter: writes 16-bit a2/a4/a3 into this+0x18C/0x188/0x18A and ORs bit 0x10000 into the flags field at this+0xEC to mark the update pending; returns the updated flags. No guard; always writes. Called by sub_4FCEE0 (0x004FCEE0).

Walks the UI element linked list (head this+0x204, next element+0x10), rewriting each state entry as a2 | (~a3 & old) over the state-entry array (element+0x11C pointer, element+0x118 count). When a2 bit 5 is set, derives a color word from global counter 0x008B8F28+432 and applies it to sub-element color slots (SingleCallWrapper_e0e0 0x0054E0E0 / Wrapper_e0f0 0x0054E0F0); otherwise, when a3 bit 5 is set, dispatches state-change callbacks by the low 2 bits of the new state (0x0055D900 / 0x0055DA50 / 0x0055E320) plus 0x0055EB30 when the element flag 0x400000 is set.

Per-frame scene focus and render update: guarded by a2 != this and a non-null render-state descriptor at this+0x1E0. Clears UI focus global 0x008C5F44, prepares the render batch transform (0x0054B570), sets busy bit 0x20000000 on the sub-object at this+0x204 and issues an indirect D3D wrapper call through global 0x008B8F24 vtable+4, then stores RenderListIteration (0x0054F710) into 0x008C5F40 and runs SceneBatchRenderCheck (0x0054F5C0).

Builds vertex/index buffer resources for the mesh object at this+0x50, dispatching on the mode word at this+0x32 (bit 0 vs bit 1 LOD layouts). Allocates and fills a 36-byte vertex-buffer descriptor (size 32, width this+0x2C*this+0x24, height this+0x2C*this+0x28, stride 64, format 1234) at *(this+0x50)+0x1C and a 28-byte index-buffer descriptor (count 2, mesh height) at *(this+0x50)+0x24, creates them via 0x00540DF0 / 0x00540FC0, writes UV pairs and triangle-strip index patterns, copies generated index data to *(this+0x50)+0x28, finalizes via 0x00540D40 / 0x00540DA0, and returns -1 with aErrorCreatingV on creation failure.

Stores integer a3 into one of three per-group alpha/scale fields selected by a2 (1->0x14, 2->0x24, 3->0x34), refreshes DirectX vertex-buffer texture coordinates via DirectXVertexBufferTextureCoordinateSetup (0x005416A0) using this+0x4 and the selected group mode, and sets the 0x800 dirty flag in the UI root at 0x008B8F28 (+0xEC). Returns the UI root pointer. Called by sub_4FCEE0 / sub_55A500.

Builds a CSR-like sparse-matrix symbolic pattern from the dense matrix a2 (dimension a4): normalizes non-zero entries, counts rows/entries, allocates four arrays into this+0x0/0x4/0x8/0xC (row starts, column indices, value offsets, packed column bytes), then fills row-start pointers, per-row column indices and packed value offsets. Returns a4. Frees prior storage via QuadPointerFree (0x0056CF10).

Thread-management routine: while holding the mutex at this+0xD4 (timeout this+0xD8), computes a float on a sub-object via FloatAdditionReturnsFUN00568d90Param1 (0x00583680) / FloatSetWithTimingCall (0x00583660) and releases the mutex; then, if a thread handle exists at this+0x4, takes a second mutex at this+0x20 (timeout this+0x24) and, when the suspend flag at this+0x1C is set, resumes the thread up to 50 attempts with increasing sleeps until its suspend count drops below 2, clearing the flag. Returns 0 on resume failure, else 1.

Mutex-protected field write: when the mutex handle at this+0x5B8 is non-null and WaitForSingleObject(timeout this+0x5BC) returns 0 or 128, writes a2 through the field pointer at this+0x5B4 and releases the mutex; on guard failure the store dereferences null (a latent crash path). Returns the written field pointer.

Stores the locale-facet reference returned by sub_59AAB9 into this+0x0, then, under lock (sub_59A54D / sub_59A5E9), thread-safely increments the global reference counter 0x008D4650 via CounterIncrementThreadSafe (0x00598C4A). Returns this.

Thread-safe increment of the counter field at this+0x4, guarded against the -1 sentinel: enters a critical section (sub_59A54D), increments unless the value is -1, leaves the critical section (sub_59A5E9), and returns its status.

classes.name: GraphicsDeviceConfiguration

All packet owners are UnknownObject; the class boundary and field names are synthesis (GUESS), grounded only in the shared this-offset regions and callee set.

state_machines.name: UiFocusState
state_machines.transitions: UIFocusChange clears the global focus flag 0x008C5F44 each frame, then sets the busy bit 0x20000000 on the element list head (this+0x204) while processing the render list; the exact focus set-path is not evidenced beyond the clear + busy-bit sequence.

state_machines.name: UiElementStateBitfield
state_machines.transitions: Each state-entry word is rewritten as new = a2 | (~a3 & old); the low two bits of the new state select the callback (0x0055D900 / 0x0055DA50 / 0x0055E320) and bit 5 of a2 selects the color/texture path (SingleCallWrapper_e0e0 / Wrapper_e0f0).

interfaces.name: DirectXAdapterDeviceVtable
interfaces.purpose: Polymorphic adapter/device interface whose vtable slots are probed and invoked by ConfigureDirect3DDevice (0x0053E070): mode negotiation +40, multisample +44, capabilities +20, device creation +56/+60, render-target setup +64, extended setup +124/+200. Slots are observed through the object pointers at this+0x10FC and this+0x1100; the interface identity is not confirmed.

interfaces.name: BufferedCharacterWriter
interfaces.purpose: Byte-oriented write sink: WriteUInt32BytesLittleEndian (0x005355F0) emits four least-significant-first bytes through BufferedCharacterWriteWithOverflowHandling (0x00589898), and StreamFileTypeCheckWithDispatch (0x005355A0) is the observed caller. The sink object layout is caller-defined and unresolved.

interfaces.name: DirectXSurfaceInterface
interfaces.purpose: Surface object interface whose vtable+8 releases temporary surfaces and vtable+60 prepares surfaces in the blit path (0x0053FD40). Slot semantics are inferred from raw source only; interface identity is not confirmed.

compatibility_contracts.name: AudioResampleFilterTableLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement for 0x00502C28 must allocate a filter table whose per-output segment stores (source-index dword, weight float) record pairs plus per-phase byte lengths, with a trailing total byte size written before returning the table pointer, and must return null when either size is zero or the allocation fails. The clamp (a3==0) vs wrap behavior of source positions is part of the observable contract.

compatibility_contracts.name: UInt32LittleEndianByteSerialization
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement for 0x005355F0 must emit a 32-bit value as exactly four bytes in least-significant-byte-first order through the buffered character writer (0x00589898) and propagate the last write's result. StreamFileTypeCheckWithDispatch (0x005355A0) relies on the byte order.

compatibility_contracts.name: DirectXDeviceSurfaceConfigurationDefaults
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement for 0x0053D4F0 must reset the device globals 0x008B6AC8/0x008B6AB8, zero-initialize eight render-pass sub-structures (17-dword strides from dword index 1118), and apply the fixed defaults: 8192/32768 buffer limits, identity 1.0f scales, debug color key 11513775, 640x480 viewport with 7680x1200 backing, and buffer parameters 512/6. It must return this.

compatibility_contracts.name: GuidHexStringFormat
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement for 0x0053D8E0 must read the GUID payload at +0x0 (Data1 dword), +0x4 (Data2 word), +0x6 (Data3 word) and +0x8..+0xF (Data4 bytes) and format it with the literal "%.8X-%.4X-%.4X-%.2X%.2X-%.2X%.2X%.2X%.2X%.2X%.2X" (0x005DBC5C) via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck into the caller's buffer, propagating its result.

compatibility_contracts.name: UiElementPositionDirtyFlag
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement for 0x00543870 must write the three 16-bit position values into this+0x188/0x18A/0x18C and OR bit 0x10000 into the flags word at this+0xEC, returning the updated flags value.

compatibility_contracts.name: MeshVertexIndexBufferLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement for 0x00558310 must create a vertex buffer from a descriptor with size 32, width = this+0x2C*this+0x24, height = this+0x2C*this+0x28, stride 64 and format 1234 via 0x00540DF0, and an index buffer from a descriptor with count 2 and the mesh height via 0x00540FC0, then copy the generated index data and return -1 with the aErrorCreatingV path on creation failure.

compatibility_contracts.name: ThreadResumeMutexProtocol
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement for 0x00585680 must protect the value update with the mutex at this+0xD4 (accepting WAIT_OBJECT_0 or WAIT_ABANDONED from WaitForSingleObject), and when a thread handle exists at this+0x4, under the mutex at this+0x20, resume the thread until its suspend count is below 2 (up to 50 attempts with increasing sleeps) when the suspend flag at this+0x1C is set, returning 0 on resume failure and 1 otherwise.

compatibility_contracts.name: MutexGuardedFieldWrite
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement for 0x00585CD0 must, when the mutex handle at this+0x5B8 is non-null and WaitForSingleObject(timeout this+0x5BC) returns 0 or 128, store a2 into the field at this+0x5B4 and release the mutex, returning the field pointer. The unconditional store even on guard failure (null dereference) is part of the current behavior and should be preserved or explicitly decided.

compatibility_contracts.name: LocaleRefcountIncrement
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement for 0x00598C1C must store the locale-facet reference (from 0x0059AAB9) into the object's offset 0x0 and, under the lock pair 0x0059A54D/0x0059A5E9, increment the global reference counter 0x008D4650 via CounterIncrementThreadSafe (0x00598C4A), returning the object pointer.

compatibility_contracts.name: ThreadSafeCounterIncrement
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement for 0x00598C4A must enter the critical section, increment the counter at this+0x4 unless it holds the -1 sentinel, leave the critical section, and return the release status.

Element-linked offsets this+0x224, this+0x228, this+0x330 and this+0x350 (0x0054BDC0) and this+0x218 (0x0054F7A0) are read per packet facts but their writers and semantics are unresolved.
